files.description: Read to place a backend test suite — where a given suite belongs under test/.
Read when the diff tests browser behavior — the e2e versus unit split, and the e2e harness.
Read for TypeScript module shape — dependency injection, file-split seams, zod boundaries, helpers, and the @/ import aliases.

Read when the diff touches ui/src/lib/diffview/ or the SourceView / DiffPlanView plan surface — the layer pipeline, transform-in-place, line parity, the token partition, and the idempotency the MutationObservers require.
